name: Hardware
description: The Hardware team is in charge of designing and optimizing the devices, so we are looking for people interested in: Design and maintenance of biomedical equipment. Skill with embedded systems and their applications in robotics. A good level of English and leadership skills are valued.

name: Social Media
description: The Social Media team handles social networks and digital communication, so the main characteristics sought in applicants are: Video editing. Content design. Management of social networks. A good level of English and leadership skills are valued.

name: Outreach
description: The Outreach team seeks to establish external relationships and alliances, which is why the team seeks: Event management and organization capacity. Ease of oral and written communication. Interpersonal and networking skills. A good level of English and leadership skills are valued.

name: Data Science
description: The Data Science team works with large volumes of data to find patterns, which is why we are looking for people interested in: Machine Learning. Experience with data management and analysis. Signal processing. A good level of English and leadership skills are valued.

name: Software
description: The Software team is in charge of design, develop and maintenance of the operation systems and programs in our club. That´s why the team is looking for people interested in design of software and has experience with it. Skills needed: a good level of English and leadership skills.

name: Education
description: The Education team is dedicated to training and continuous education, so we are looking for people to: Prepare educational content. Management of digital tools for editing. Passion for teaching. A good level of English and leadership skills are valued.
